question: Who became the first Indian woman to win two gold medals at the 2024 Paralympic Games in Paris?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Avani Lekhara**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Avani Lekhara** became the first Indian woman to win two gold medals at the 2024 Paralympic Games in Paris.
 
• She secured her first gold medal in the **R2 - Women's 10m Air Rifle Standing SH1** event.
 
• Her second gold medal came in the **R8 - Women's 50m Rifle 3 Positions SH1** event.
 
• Avani Lekhara is a trailblazer in Indian para-shooting, having previously won gold at the 2020 Tokyo Paralympics.
 
• She is celebrated for her resilience and determination, overcoming a severe spinal cord injury to achieve international success.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Paralympic Games**

 
 
• The Paralympic Games are a major international multi-sport event involving athletes with a range of disabilities.
 
• They are organized in parallel with the Olympic Games and take place shortly after the conclusion of the Olympics.
 
• The Games include various categories such as amputee, cerebral palsy, intellectual disability, wheelchair, and visually impaired sports.
 
• The International Paralympic Committee (IPC) is responsible for organizing the Games.
 
 
 
• **Shooting Sports in Paralympics**
 
 
• Shooting is one of the sports contested at the Paralympic Games, governed by the International Paralympic Committee.
 
• The sport is open to athletes with physical impairments and includes rifle and pistol events.
 
• Athletes compete in different categories based on the type and extent of their impairments.
 
• Competitions are held in both standing and seated positions to accommodate the range of disabilities.
 
 
 
• **SH1 and SH2 Categories**
 
 
• SH1 category is for athletes who can support the weight of the firearm with their arms.
 
• SH2 category is for athletes who have an impairment in the upper limbs and require a shooting stand to support the firearm.
 
• These classifications ensure fair competition among athletes with similar levels of function.
 
 
 
• **Avani Lekhara's Achievements**
 
 
• Avani Lekhara won gold in the 10m Air Rifle Standing SH1 event at the 2020 Tokyo Paralympics.
 
• She is also a recipient of the prestigious Khel Ratna Award, India's highest sporting honor.
 
• Avani has consistently performed at international shooting competitions, bringing laurels to the country.
